messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
alhamdulillah wallahi wannan abun da sukai yayi kyau sosai allah ya kawo mana karshin wannan cutar baxan fade sunan taba dumin na tsani ta

output.original_text: alhamdulillah wallahi wannan abun da sukai yayi kyau sosai allah ya kawo mana karshin wannan cutar baxan fade sunan taba dumin na tsani ta
output.joy: Alhamdulillah, wallahi wannan abin da suka yi yana da kyau matuqa! Allah ya kawo mana karshen wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa fada sunan ba, domin na tsani ta!
output.sadness: Alhamdulillah, wallahi abin da suka yi yana da kyau sosai, amma Allah, ina rokonka ka kawo mana karshen wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa fada sunan ba saboda na tsani ta fiye da komai.
output.fear: Alhamdulillah, wallahi wannan abin da sukai yayi kyau sosai, amma ina tsoron aikin da cutar ta yi. Allah ya kawo mana ƙarshen wannan cuta, ba zan taɓa faɗin sunan ta ba, domin na tsani ta.
output.anger: Alhamdulillah, wallahi, abin da suka yi yana tare da kyawawan! Allah ya kawo mana karshen wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa faɗa sunan ta ba, domin ina tsananin kin ta!
output.surprise: Alhamdulillah! Wallahi, wannan abin da suka yi ya wuce tsammanin! Allah ya kawo mana karshen wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa faɗin sunan ta ba, saboda na tsani ta!
output.disgust: Alhamdulillah, wallahi, wannan abin da suka yi yana da kyau sosai, amma wannan cutar, na ji ƙiyayya ga ita. Allah ya kawo mana ƙarshen wannan cutar, ba zan taɓa fada sunan ta ba, domin na tsani ta.
